desc.zh: 从提前到达终点的失败，推导覆盖每个格子的回溯计数。
desc.en: Derive complete-walk backtracking from an early arrival that fails.

complexity: O(mn + 3^V) time; O(V) auxiliary space, V non-obstacle cells

concepts.name: Backtracking
concepts.description: Visit, explore and restore each branch.

concepts.name: Complete-walk invariant
concepts.description: Remaining cells and the current route determine valid completion.
